episodes.synopsis: When Sabato gets caught distributing fake Shinigami Gold licenses, Rinne discovers that his father might have been a genius Shinigami in high school!
episodes.title: Gold License

episodes.synopsis: A ghost hand seems to have a grudge against a member of the track team. Later, Sakura discovers a mysterious female spirit who demands art students to draw her face.
episodes.title: The Cursed Ace / Draw Me

episodes.synopsis: Rinne and the other Shinigami are tasked with cleaning the Wheel of Reincarnation. The dangerous work only gets worse when a brawl breaks out, and Damashigami enter the scene.
episodes.title: Wheel of Reincarnation Cleanup Day / Infinite Malice / A Puppy in the Rain

episodes.synopsis: Sakura meets a fortune teller who illegally possesses a Shinigami tool. Rinne goes to collect it, but the fortune teller won't give up her crystal ball without a fight.
episodes.title: Ane at the Shopping Mall

episodes.synopsis: Tamako asks Rinne to train a young black cat to support a Shinigami, but this cat's particular phobia gets in the way. Later, Rinne hopes to intercept a "lucky" pot of money!
episodes.title: Kuroboshi Sansei / The Lucky Pot / Bamboo Shoot in Rainbow Color

episodes.synopsis: Shoma offers to pay Rinne handsomely to take care of a sacred bird, forgetting to mention the bird's frightening appetite. Later, Sakura meets the ghost of an angry bride.
episodes.title: Special Protected Sacred Bird / June Bride / The Safe from Hell

episodes.synopsis: Jumonji finally gets a chance to impress Sakura when he tries to quell a mischievous spirit. Later, Sakura and Rinne help a "creepy" spirit give the performance of his life.
episodes.title: Wandering Power Stone / Poltergeist / The Taboo in the Shinigami World

episodes.synopsis: A cursed doll from Ageha's past comes to haunt Renge. Later, Rinne helps a spirit by setting her up on a date with Matsugo, despite Matsugo's lingering affections for Rinne!
episodes.title: Open After Seven Days / Silver Scythe / Prince of the Shinigami

episodes.synopsis: Sabato falls victim to the mackerel curse! Later, Jumonji invites Sakura to study for a test at his place, only to have his alone time with her horribly interrupted.
episodes.title: Apologize in the Altar Room / Goddess of Wisdom / River of Treasure

episodes.synopsis: Someone is trying to take over the Damashigami Company! Later, when Renge tries to steal Annette's Peep Ball, she sees a vision of Kain... putting handcuffs on her?
episodes.title: The First Union Meeting / An Ominous Prophecy

episodes.synopsis: A search for Kain goes awry as Ageha and Matsugo continue to fight for Rinne's affection. Later, Sakura notices that Rinne, who never studies, is passing every test. How?
episodes.title: Mystery of the Flower Field / I Will Lend You My Right Arm / Black Report Card

episodes.synopsis: Rinne tries to purify a poltergeist, and Sakura helps a spirit who's scared of eggplants. Later, the group takes a trip to a festival to bust a Damashigami scheme.
episodes.title: Evil Spirit in the Summer House / Eggplant Romance / One Coin Investigation

episodes.synopsis: While visiting a pawn shop Rinne discovers something related to his mother, and learns more about her. Later, Sakura and Rinne check on a little girl who can see spirits.
episodes.title: Otome the Shinigami

episodes.synopsis: Sabato reveals an interesting detail concerning the disappearance of Rinne's mother, leading the others to a startling revelation about little Ichigo's true identity.
episodes.title: Lies and Truth

episodes.synopsis: Ichigo asks Rinne to banish "Kokkuri-san". Sabato tries to offload a cursed piggy bank. Later, Sansei makes another attempt to fight his fear of spirits.
episodes.title: Kokkuri-san / Cursed Piggy Bank / The Hated Sansei

episodes.synopsis: Stingy Annette finds herself suddenly unable to save money. Is it truly a snake spirit's curse? Later, Masato attempts to sabotage Rinne's happiness... again.
episodes.title: Curse of Splurge / The Cursed Peep Ball

episodes.synopsis: Refuto hires Rinne to protect an offering of delicious dumplings. Later, Rinne looks forward to a Saury Festival... with one hidden condition.
episodes.title: Head Man / When You Wish Upon the Moon / The First Saury Festival

episodes.synopsis: Rinne's dreams are being invaded by a Dream Demon. To stop the madness, Rinne and Matsugo have to capture a it in a world where one person's dream is another's nightmare!
episodes.title: The Practical Training for Capturing a Dream Demon

episodes.synopsis: Incidents around steamed buns make life difficult for Rinne and Rokumon. Later, Rinne experiences a problem originating from a mysterious package of mushrooms.
episodes.title: Nothing Inside / Mystery of Koshikudake Hill / Effect of the Matsutake Mushroom

episodes.synopsis: Something terrible has happened to Matsugo: he's turned into an angel! Worse, he's HELPING people! Later, Sakura and Ichigo bump into Shoma as he tries to help a hippo spirit.
episodes.title: Wings of Celebration / Kabakichi-kun / Scream of a Cassette Tape

episodes.synopsis: Rinne is suspected of stealing money at his own school! On the hunt to find the actual perpetrator, he discovers how little faith his friends have in him and his poverty.
episodes.title: Black Square Thing / Shortcut Through the Alley

episodes.synopsis: Ageha has one last chance to stop her sister from making the biggest mistake of her life: marrying Sabato! Later, Rinne discovers that Rokumon may have a secret food supply.
episodes.title: A Ring and Stamp / Food at the Porch / Black Cat Children’s Association

episodes.synopsis: The new wax finish on Rinne's scythe is attracting coins! Later, Sakura helps her friends Miho and Rika when a walking mannequin attacks them.
episodes.title: Good Luck Wax / Maneko and Kotomi / Where’s My Money?!

episodes.synopsis: Sakura finds herself dealing with a fierce dog spirit... but is he really a dog? Later, Rinne wonders if his never ending money problems can be solved by a money spirit.
episodes.title: Supplemental Class for Fierce Dog Catching / Money Spirit / Evil Spirit’s Legacy

episodes.synopsis: Matsugo invites Rinne to his school festival, so (of course) Sakura, Jumonji, and Renge come along. The festival's ghost-house proves more dangerous than they thought.
episodes.title: A Promise in the Underworld
